text: The wave equation ∂²u/∂t² = c²∇²u is the prototype ___ PDE, the class for which information propagates at finite speed along characteristics (the light-cone directions x ± ct = const).
explanation: With discriminant B² − AC > 0 the wave equation is hyperbolic; its characteristics x ± ct = const are the propagation directions, giving the finite domain of dependence and domain of influence that express causality. Elliptic (Laplace) and parabolic (heat) equations are the other two classes.
